Research, Evaluation, and Writing

Services: Research, Evaluation, and Writing

 

When you’re busy with important work, it’s hard to keep abreast of the latest trends and best practices — but knowing who’s doing what can help strengthen your efforts. We cull, curate, and capture innovative ideas in accessible ways, ensuring that grounded peer wisdom helps build fields and movements. 

Research, evaluation, and writing services include: 

  • Producing case studies and descriptive narrative reports

  • Evaluating programs and processes through narrative storytelling, interviews, surveys, and other qualitative methods 

  • Conducting funder mapping

  • Producing trends reports

  • Gathering stakeholder input through interviews, focus groups, and other participatory processes 

 
 

Select project examples: 

  • Published field report based on interviews with leaders of philanthropy support organizations exploring factors that encourage or impede funders’ sustained embrace of community power building strategies. Report includes a rich resource repository for investing in community leadership.

  • Published field report based on research with community development, education, and early childhood funders and philanthropy support organization leaders exploring how local and regional foundations are investing in systemic change while pursuing rapid response to the COVID pandemic.

  • Published case study of the Community for Public Education Reform Fund, a national-local funder collaborative engaging nearly 80 funder members investing in community-led strategies for educational equity and intersectional justice concerns. Supported groups and alliances achieved over 90 systemic policy reforms on the local, state, and federal level.

 

Dr. Fine’s collaborative approach and her perceptive analysis of all facets of the foundation’s civic education initiative enabled us to fully gauge its strengths and weaknesses and to decide wisely about its further development. She brought an incisive, but fully sympathetic, approach to her work with us and with those she interviewed on behalf of the project. We have the highest regard for Dr. Fine’s professional experience and abilities, the breadth and depth of her knowledge, her access to expert colleagues, and above all her commitment to meeting a client’s needs.

~ Gail Levin | Former Executive Director, Annenberg Foundation
